issue.close_reason: Implemented complete runtime .gitignore generation for new .beads workspaces. The implementation creates .gitignore only for brand-new workspaces (when .beads directory did not exist before init), preserves custom .gitignore files byte-for-byte in existing workspaces, and excludes all runtime artifacts (database files, traces, diagnostics, locks, journals, temporary files) while leaving config.json and checkpoint content trackable. Added comprehensive regression tests covering new-workspace ignore semantics, trackable durable files, existing custom .gitignore preservation, and existing workspace without .gitignore. All 19 tests pass. Implementation avoids check-then-create races using fresh_workspace flag to track whether .beads existed before init invocation.
issue.description: Update bead-rs initialization so a brand-new .beads directory receives a .beads/.gitignore that excludes runtime-only database artifacts, traces, diagnostics, locks, journals, and temporary files while leaving config.json and checkpoint content trackable. Create the ignore file only when this init invocation creates the .beads directory. If .beads existed before init, do not create, overwrite, merge, or otherwise edit its .gitignore, including fresh-clone recovery with config and checkpoint present but no database. Preserve custom ignore files byte-for-byte. Add regression tests for new-workspace ignore semantics, trackable durable files, an existing custom .gitignore, and an existing workspace without .gitignore. Avoid check-then-create races so concurrent initialization cannot overwrite an existing directory or ignore file.
issue.title: Generate complete runtime .gitignore only for new .beads workspaces

issue.description:
ADR-002 makes agent-guided rehydration the only migration path and itself records that large repositories need batching, resumable reconciliation reports, and duplicate detection — none of which has a spec, tooling, or bead. Define a versioned reconciliation-report schema (mapping every source identifier to a native identifier or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, machine-checkable but never accepted as store input), add a validator for it, and document the batch/resume procedure for large sources.

Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
